question_cn: 为了预防被闷杀，最有效的方法是什么？
question_en: What is the most effective way to prevent a smothered mate?

options.text_cn: 把所有兵都推到对方阵营
options.text_en: Push all your pawns into the opponent's territory
Move the king to the center of the board

options.text_cn: 不要把自己的车放在王旁边
options.text_en: Do not place your rook next to your king

options.text_cn: 避免王困在角落，为王保留逃格，不要用己方棋子堵死王
options.text_en: Keep the king from becoming trapped in a corner; preserve an escape square and do not let your own pieces smother it

explanation_cn: 防止闷杀的关键是不要让王的逃格被己方棋子完全封死。若王躲在角落，要确保旁边至少有一个逃格；若车守在王身边，注意不要成为帮对方闷杀自己王的帮凶。
explanation_en: Prevent smothered mate by keeping at least one escape square open. If the king is in a corner, make sure it can move out; be careful that a rook beside the king does not help trap it.
